# Wolf fur cape

Internal ID: CapeWolf | Type: Cape | Source: Workbench | Crafting Materials: Wolf pelt x12, Silver x6 | Armor: 4 | Set Pieces: Wolf Armor | Resistances: Resistant (0.5x) vs., Frost

# Introduction

Wolf fur cape is an armor piece made of wolf pelts, silver and a wolf trophy at the workbench. It is unlocked after picking up one of each of the materials.

## Stats

• Quality: Durability | 1: 1000 | 2: 1050 | 3: 1100 | 4: 1150

• Quality: Armor | 1: 1 | 2: 2 | 3: 3 | 4: 4

• Quality: Crafting recipe | 1: 6 Wolf pelt4 Silver1 Wolf trophy | 2: 4 Wolf pelt2 Silver | 3: 8 Wolf pelt4 Silver | 4: 12 Wolf pelt6 Silver

• Quality: Workbench level | 1: 2 | 2: 3 | 3: 4 | 4: 5

## Notes

• Frost resist does not stack with frost resistance mead, Yagluth power or other armor pieces.
• Frost resist will override the frost weakness from being Wet.
• Frost resist prevents Cold and Freezing effect.
